stories.title: Josh Jacobs scores twice as Packers dispatch Panthers
stories.summary: Carolina made a game of it late, but Green Bay held on for the Thursday night win.

stories.title: Packers WR Watson returns to game after trip to hospital for chest injury
stories.summary: Christian Watson was taken to a hospital, which the team said was for precautionary reasons, during the first half of Thursday's win against the Panthers.

stories.title: 'Locked in' Gray, Dream hold off Valkyries, force first Finals Game 7
stories.summary: Allisha Gray scored 23 points as the Dream held off a late rally for an 80-69 victory over the Valkyries to force a historic Game 7 of the WNBA Finals.

stories.title: Red Wings suspend star forward Larkin as team explores trade options
stories.summary: The Red Wings announced Thursday that star forward Dylan Larkin has been suspended without pay after informing the team he no longer wanted to play for Detroit.

stories.title: Longtime football coach Jones, pioneer of run-and-shoot offense, dies at 73
stories.summary: Longtime college and pro football coach June Jones, who helped popularize the run-and-shoot offense, has died at 73.
